detail.title: Evaluation Of the Effects of Replacing the Wibor Rate by the Wiron Rate for Preferential Credits in Polish Agriculture
detail.abstract: The aim of the article is to present an assessment of the economic effects of replacing the WIBOR rate with the WIRON rate for preferential credits in Polish agriculture. The study is an in-depth case study and uses the simulation analysis method. The introduction of the WIRON 3M rate will result in a reduction in the interest rate on preferential credits granted in the future, and the nominal scale of the discount will depend on the phase of monetary policy in the country and the level of the applicable interest rates set by the National Bank of Poland (NBP). However, in the case of credits granted according to the currently applicable mechanism (interest rate based on WIBOR 3M) or the promissory note rediscount rate, the change will most likely be neutral. The largest part of the interest rate reduction in all phases of the monetary policy cycle is obtained by borrowers (farmers) using credit lines: RR (credits for investments in agriculture and inland fishing, Z (credits for the purchase of agricultural land) and most activities financed under the PR line (credits for investments in the processing of agricultural products, fish, crustaceans and molluscs, as well as the purchase of stocks and shares). In the case of disaster loans granted to insured borrowers, the only beneficiary of the index change will be the State Treasury. Quantifying the potential savings for borrowers in the agricultural sector related to changes in reference rates is not easy due to the scarcity of the available detailed data.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了波兰农业优惠贷款中WIBOR利率替换为WIRON利率的经济效应，发现WIRON 3M将降低未来优惠贷款利率，但对现有贷款机制影响中性，不同贷款类型和货币政策周期阶段受益程度不同。
AI.research_question: 将波兰农业优惠贷款中的WIBOR利率替换为WIRON利率会产生怎样的经济效应？
AI.motivation: 波兰正在推进利率基准改革（从WIBOR转向WIRON），农业优惠贷款规模庞大，该改革对农业部门借款人、政府等利益相关方的经济影响尚不明确，需要量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利率基准转换理论、货币政策传导机制、农业信贷补贴经济学。
AI.method: 深度案例研究法结合模拟分析法。
AI.findings: (1) WIRON 3M将降低未来优惠贷款利率，折扣规模取决于货币政策阶段和NBP利率水平；(2) 对现有基于WIBOR 3M或票据再贴现率的贷款机制影响中性；(3) RR、Z和大部分PR贷款线的借款人受益最大；(4) 受灾保险贷款的唯一受益者是国库；(5) 量化储蓄面临数据稀缺挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了利率基准转换在农业信贷领域的应用研究，揭示了不同贷款类型和货币政策周期下利率替换的差异化效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰政策制定者评估利率改革对农业部门的实际影响提供量化依据；为农业借款人理解利率变动带来的潜在收益提供参考；提示数据基础设施建设的必要性。

title: Observed Appetite: A Computational Framework for Measuring Commercial Insurance Carrier Underwriting Behavior at Distribution Scale

detail.title: Observed Appetite: A Computational Framework for Measuring Commercial Insurance Carrier Underwriting Behavior at Distribution Scale

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of QuoteSweep, the system described in §3 of the paper. The dataset is released openly under CC-BY-4.0 at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20280436.

detail.abstract: Determining which commercial insurance carriers will quote a given submission is a prerequisite to every commercial-lines placement, yet the signals available to independent agents-carrierself-reported appetite guides, application-programming-interface (API) responses from a small set of integrated carriers, and individual agent experience-have not been formalized as a computational object, nor measured against each other at scale. We call this measurement task observed appetite and distinguish it from the three established categories: stated appetite (carrier-published), API-revealed appetite (returned by integrated platforms), and verified appetite (confirmed directly with the carrier). Observed appetite is the empirical distribution of a carrier's quote-or-decline behavior computed from real submission outcomes through that carrier's own portal, partitioned by industry classification, geography, and risk size. We formalize observed appetite as a five-stage computational task (Submit → Classify → Aggregate → Score Confidence → Reconcile) with an explicit four-way ontology of appetite sources. We describe the QuoteSweep system, which implements the observation infrastructure through AI-powered browser agents operating on authenticated carrier portals without requiring API partnerships. We evaluate the stated appetite baseline against itself across a corpus of 509 commercial property and casualty (P&C) carriers. This paper presents the framework and the stated-appetite baseline; production-scale observed-appetite measurement is left to future work (§6.3). Only 2.2% of carriers publicly disclose any industry × state × size interaction, only 1.2% annotate appetite at six-digit NAICS resolution, and only 4.7% of line-of-business commitments specify a revenue threshold. When the same carrier's published PDF appetite guide and its own public appetite web page are compared at the NAICS-2 sector level (n = 189 carriers, 3,780 cells), the PDF asserts 2.14× more sector inclusions than the web page (PDF "in" marginal 33.7% vs. 15.7%; Cohen's κ = +0.25, 95% CI 0.22-0.28-fair agreement under Landis & Koch). Two surfaces of the same carrier describe systematically different coverage scopes. We release the corpus as an open dataset for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“观测风险偏好”概念，通过AI浏览器代理从保险公司门户自动收集承保数据，并与保险公司自行公布的“陈述风险偏好”进行大规模对比，发现两者存在显著不一致。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化地测量保险公司的实际承保风险偏好（观测风险偏好），并将其与保险公司自行陈述的风险偏好进行对比评估？
AI.motivation: 商业保险投保过程中，独立代理人依赖多种来源判断保险公司是否报价，但这些来源（保险公司自述指南、API返回、个人经验）尚未被形式化为计算对象，也未被大规模相互验证。需要将这一测量任务系统化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险偏好的四源本体论：陈述风险偏好（stated appetite）、API揭示风险偏好（API-revealed appetite）、验证风险偏好（verified appetite）、观测风险偏好（observed appetite）。观测风险偏好基于真实报价/拒绝结果的经验分布，按行业、地理、风险规模分区计算。
AI.method: 将观测风险偏好形式化为五阶段计算任务（提交→分类→聚合→评分置信度→协调）；构建QuoteSweep系统，使用AI驱动的浏览器代理在认证的保险公司门户上自动操作；对509家商业财产与意外险公司的陈述风险偏好进行基线评估。
AI.findings: 仅2.2%的保险公司公开披露行业×州×规模的交互信息；仅1.2%的保险公司在六位NAICS层面标注风险偏好；仅4.7%的业务线承诺设定收入门槛。同一保险公司的PDF指南与网页版在NAICS-2部门层面（n=189家，3,780个单元格）对比，PDF申明的行业包含率是网页版的2.14倍（PDF 33.7% vs 网页15.7%；Cohen's κ=+0.25，表明一致性较差）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将“观测风险偏好”形式化为计算任务，提出风险偏好四源本体论框架，为保险公司实际承保行为的实证测量提供了理论和方法基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 发布开放数据集以支持可重复研究；揭示了保险公司自述风险偏好与其自身不同信息渠道之间存在系统性不一致，对保险中介、投保人和监管机构具有重要实践启示。

title: A Next-Generation Deep Learning Framework to Extract Hourly Gap-Free Surface NO2 Concentrations from TEMPO NO2 Columns
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, Harvard University - Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, Harvard University - Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, Harvard University - Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics and Harvard University - Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics

detail.title: A Next-Generation Deep Learning Framework to Extract Hourly Gap-Free Surface NO2 Concentrations from TEMPO NO2 Columns
detail.abstract: TEMPO (Tropospheric Emissions: Monitoring of Pollution), a geostationary satellite instrument, enables continuous daytime monitoring of NO2 over North America. Here, we develop a novel deep learning (DL) framework to extract hourly (daylight) 2×2 km2 surface NO2 concentrations from TEMPO tropospheric column density of NO2 (TrpNO2) for August 2, 2023, to December 31, 2024. First, we impute low-quality and missing pixels in TEMPO NO2 column, improving performance against Pandora from a correlation coefficient (R) of 0.40 and a percentage mean absolute bias (MABP) of 101% for low-quality pixels to R=0.69 and MABP=34%. This gap-filling step is critical, as it recovers approximately 32% of pixels in our TEMPO domain. Unlike point-based NO2 monitoring stations, our product provides gap-free surface NO2 maps across TEMPO domain, substantially enhancing NO2 monitoring capabilities. Second, we fuse gap-free TrpNO2 with in-situ NO2 observations to generate preliminary NO2 grids (”TEMPO-Fused NO2”). Third, a residual neural network (ResNet) incorporates TEMPO-Fused NO2 and other variables to generate the final gap-free surface NO2 product over the TEMPO domain. Validation against in-situ stations shows an unprecedented accuracy of DL framework at surface NO2 estimation (R=0.98, mean absolute bias (MAB)=0.81 ppb, and MABP=12.3%). The model also generalizes well spatially (R=0.95; MABP=21.4%) and remains accurate within imputed regions (R=0.97; MABP=16.5%). Despite NO2 differences between urban and rural environments, our DL framework performs strongly (R=0.93; MABP=25.3%) in rural regions when trained only on urban stations. We also provide hourly grids of NO2 estimation epistemic uncertainty to aid users in identifying pixels that require cautious interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了基于深度学习的框架，利用TEMPO卫星数据生成北美上空逐小时、2×2公里分辨率的地表NO₂浓度产品，填补缺失像素（恢复约32%区域），融合卫星与地面观测数据，经残差神经网络后验证精度达R=0.98，MAB=0.81 ppb，并提供了不确定性估计。
AI.research_question: 如何利用TEMPO地球静止卫星的氮 dioxide柱浓度数据，融合深度学习与地面观测，生成高时空分辨率、无空隙的北美地表NO₂浓度产品？
AI.motivation: 现有NO₂监测存在两大瓶颈：一是卫星数据存在大量低质量和缺失像素（约32%），二是缺乏逐小时、高分辨率（2×2 km）的无缝隙地表NO₂浓度图。TEMPO卫星虽能连续白天监测，但原始数据质量不足，亟需一种能够填补数据空缺、融合多源信息并精确估算地表浓度的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 数据插补理论（低质量/缺失像素修复）；2. 多源数据融合（卫星柱浓度与地面站点观测融合）；3. 残差神经网络（ResNet）的深度学习映射理论；4. 不确定性量化理论（epistemic uncertainty）。
AI.method: 三阶段深度学习框架：阶段一，对TEMPO NO₂柱浓度进行低质量和缺失像素插补（提升R从0.40到0.69，MABP从101%降至34%）；阶段二，将无缝隙TrpNO₂与地面原位NO₂观测融合生成初步网格（"TEMPO-Fused NO₂"）；阶段三，利用残差神经网络（ResNet）整合TEMPO-Fused NO₂及其他协变量，输出最终无缝隙地表NO₂产品。研究时间为2023年8月2日至2024年12月31日，空间分辨率为2×2 km，时间分辨率为逐小时。
AI.findings: 1. 最终产品验证精度为R=0.98，MAB=0.81 ppb，MABP=12.3%；2. 空间泛化能力良好（R=0.95，MABP=21.4%）；3. 在插补区域仍保持高精度（R=0.97，MABP=16.5%）；4. 仅用城市站点训练时，在农村区域仍有强表现（R=0.93，MABP=25.3%）；5. 提供了逐小时NO₂估算的认知不确定性网格。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将深度学习与TEMPO地球静止卫星数据结合，实现了逐小时、2 km分辨率的无缝隙地表NO₂反演，拓展了卫星遥感与地面观测融合的理论边界；2. 证明了残差神经网络在多源异构数据（卫星、地面、辅助变量）融合中的有效性，为同类大气污染监测提供了方法论范式；3. 引入了认知不确定性量化，为遥感产品的可信度评估建立了新标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了北美首个逐小时、2×2 km、无空隙的地表NO₂浓度产品，极大提升了NO₂监测的时空覆盖能力；2. 数据可服务于空气质量预警、健康暴露评估、排放源反演及政策制定；3. 不确定性信息帮助用户识别需谨慎解读的像素，增强了产品的可用性与透明性；4. 在城市站点数据有限的情况下仍能有效推断农村区域，降低了地面监测网络的部署成本。

title: Three Problems of the Finances of Polish Agriculture
affiliations: National Research Institute - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI), National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI), National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI) and Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute

detail.title: Three Problems of the Finances of Polish Agriculture

AI.tldr: 本文研究了波兰农业金融中的三个关键问题：资金流动、外部资本的重要性以及农作物和牲畜保险。通过混合方法（系统文献综述与2004-2022年统计数据的实证分析），发现当前十年初波兰农业金融累积了三大负面现象：盈余资金生成停滞、农业保险停滞以及信贷债务名义和实际下降。这些问题源于多部门及农业环境因素，短期内难以逆转。
AI.research_question: 波兰农业金融中资金流动、外部资本（信贷与租赁）以及农作物和牲畜保险领域的过程、趋势与挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 这三个领域主观上被认为对波兰农业部门的运行与发展至关重要，且当前时期出现了负面现象的积累，需要系统识别和描述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业金融理论、资金流动分析、外部资本（信贷与租赁）在农业中的作用、农业保险理论。
AI.method: 混合方法设计（MMD）：结合修改后的系统文献综述（反向滚雪球法加手动检索）与实证分析（2004-2022年公开统计数据及公共机构数据）。
AI.findings: 当前十年初波兰农业金融累积了三大负面现象：盈余资金生成停滞、农作物和牲畜保险停滞、信贷债务名义和实际下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业金融领域提供了波兰农业资金流动、外部资本与保险的综合分析框架，揭示了三个负面现象的共存及其系统性关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出波兰农业金融当前面临的三大问题及其多部门根源，为政策制定者提供参考，强调短期逆转的困难性。

title: Spatio-Temporal Assessment of Surface Water Quality, Heavy Metal Contamination, and Health Risks from ASGM in Ghana
affiliations: University of Energy & Natural Resources, University of Energy and Natural Resources (UENR) - Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, University of Energy and Natural Resources (UENR) and University of Energy & Natural Resources

detail.title: Spatio-Temporal Assessment of Surface Water Quality, Heavy Metal Contamination, and Health Risks from ASGM in Ghana
detail.abstract: Surface water quality in sub-Saharan Africa is being damaged by artisanal and small-scale gold mining (ASGM) but limited numbers of studies combine long-term data, quantitative health risk models and community exposure data. We examined surface water quality and human health risks in the Asutifi North District of Ghana, a river basin subject to ASGM and agriculture for the last 20 years. Water quality data (2011–2025; >2700 points) from 8 sites were analysed for WQI, Cpk, non-carcinogenic and carcinogenic health risk and using IDW and a community survey (N = 189). Four sites were classed as Unsuitable for Drinking (WQI = 215–348) and dominated by Cd and secondarily As and Pb. Of the 29 parameters monitored 19 fell below WHO/Ghana limits (Cpk < 1.00); 5 sites were in negative Cpk space (indicating a system in structural failure). The hazard index was >10 for young children in high exposure scenarios and even above 5 for 70% treatment efficiency. Total Cancer risk was >10 at every site for adults. Sensitivity analyses show contamination concentration to be the most important parameter and duration of exposure to be irrelevant due to a mathematical cancellation. Long-term, point-source pollution, indicates that remediation is needed at mine discharges rather than at the site level. This analysis provided data for emergency water supply and mine drainage treatment.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了加纳Asutifi North地区2011-2025年地表水水质数据和社区调查，发现手工和小规模采金活动导致4个采样点水质不适合饮用（WQI=215-348），镉、砷、铅为主要污染物；儿童高风险场景下危害指数>10，成人总致癌风险>10；研究建议需在矿排口进行源头修复而非现场治理。
AI.research_question: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区手工和小规模采金活动如何影响地表水水质及人类健康风险？
AI.motivation: 尽管手工和小规模采金正损害撒哈拉以南非洲的地表水水质，但结合长期数据、定量健康风险模型和社区暴露数据的研究十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 水质指数(WQI)、污染指数(Cpk)、非致癌和致癌健康风险评估模型、反距离加权插值(IDW)
AI.method: 收集2011-2025年8个站点>2700个水质数据，进行WQI、Cpk、非致癌和致癌健康风险分析，结合IDW空间插值和社区调查(N=189)。
AI.findings: 4个站点水质不适合饮用(WQI=215-348)，以镉、砷、铅污染为主；5个站点处于Cpk负值空间（结构失效）；年轻儿童高风险场景下危害指数>10，70%处理效率下仍>5；成人各站点总致癌风险>10；敏感性分析显示污染物浓度最关键，暴露时长因数学抵消不相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了长期点源污染的系统性结构失效特征，发现暴露时长在数学模型中与风险无关的抵消机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应急供水方案和矿排水处理提供了数据支撑，指出修复应聚焦矿排口而非现场层面。

title: Heterogeneity in the Level of Technical Efficiency of Farms in the European Union Regions and its Relationship to Indebtedness
affiliations: Poznań University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Heterogeneity in the Level of Technical Efficiency of Farms in the European Union Regions and its Relationship to Indebtedness

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Greene的"真实"固定效应模型和欧盟农场会计数据网络（FADN）数据，分析了农场负债水平与技术效率之间的关系。结果发现，对外部资本的更高依赖会降低技术效率，同时验证了欧盟农业存在规模报酬递增以及结构性因素（地区异质性）的重要作用。
AI.research_question: 农场负债水平与其技术效率之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 农场负债是农业投资的重要资金来源，但过度负债可能影响生产效率。厘清负债与技术效率的关系，有助于优化信贷支持政策，避免过度投资或资源错配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机前沿分析（Stochastic Frontier Analysis）、Greene的"真实"固定效应模型、规模报酬递增理论
AI.method: 采用Greene的"真实"固定效应模型，结合欧盟农场会计数据网络（FADN）的区域面板数据，在随机前沿分析框架下估算技术效率及其决定因素。
AI.findings: （1）对外部资本依赖程度越高，技术效率水平越低；（2）欧盟农业存在规模报酬递增；（3）结构性因素（区域异质性）在农业生产效率中扮演重要角色，这种异质性打破了传统"新"成员国与"老"成员国的效率划分。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了负债水平与技术效率之间的负向关系，丰富了农业经济学中关于资本结构与生产效率关系的理论认识；揭示了区域异质性对传统欧盟成员国分类的修正作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟及各国农业信贷政策提供实证依据，建议重新审视以信贷为基础的政策工具；提示政策制定者关注过度投资风险，尤其是优惠贷款和绿色投资可能带来的效率损失。

title: Place and Role of Large-Scale Farms in Polish Agriculture
affiliations: National Research Institute - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI) and National Research Institute (PIB) - Institute of Agricultural and Food Economics - National Research Institute (IAFE-NRI)

detail.title: Place and Role of Large-Scale Farms in Polish Agriculture
detail.abstract: The main aim of this study is to assess changes in the structure of farms in Poland after the political and economic transformations initiated in 1989. Changes in the structure of farms and their areas will be presented against the background of selected European Union (EU) countries. The following EU-15 countries were selected: Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands, Finland, France, Ireland, Germany, Sweden, and the United Kingdom. Of the countries that joined the EU in 2004, the selected nations were Czechia, Lithuania, Slovakia, and Hungary, and in 2007, Bulgaria and Romania. In analyzing changes in the structure of farms in Poland, special attention was paid to the place and role of largescale farms. The sources of research materials were statistical data and literature. The comparative method was used in the analysis of research materials. The faster rate of increase in labor costs in the national economy and the prices of inputs for agriculture compared to the selling prices of agricultural products caused a decline in the unit profitability of agricultural production. In this situation, farmers reacted defensively by increasing the scale of production, mainly by expanding farm areas, which led to the creation of large-scale enterprises of 100 hectares or more of agricultural land. In Poland, a factor conducive to the creation of such units was the ownership transformation of state-owned farms (PGRs) caused by the political and economic changes in 1989. The current policy towards large-scale enterprises leasing State Treasury land threatens their functioning. Restricting the development possibilities of this group of enterprises is not conducive to improving the structure of farms. It threatens to reduce production and may also cause social unrest because these enterprises are significant employers in rural areas.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1989年政治经济转型后波兰农场结构的变化，重点关注大型农场（≥100公顷）的地位与作用，发现劳动力成本上升和农业投入品价格涨幅高于农产品售价导致农户通过扩大经营面积来应对，而国有农场（PGRs）的所有制转型也促进了大型农场的形成。当前政策限制租赁国有土地的大型企业发展，可能损害农业生产、农场结构改善并引发农村社会问题。
AI.research_question: 1989年政治经济转型后，波兰农场结构发生了怎样的变化？大型农场在其中的地位和作用如何？
AI.motivation: 波兰1989年转型后农业结构发生深刻变化，且当前政策对大型租赁企业构成限制，可能影响农业生产和农村社会稳定性，因此有必要系统评估这一变革过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业结构调整理论；规模经济与成本-收益分析；转型经济中的所有权变革理论。
AI.method: 比较法；统计分析；基于统计数据和文献资料的二手数据分析。
AI.findings: （1）劳动力成本和农业投入品价格增速超过农产品售价，导致农业单位利润率下降，农户通过扩大农场面积（≥100公顷）实现防御性应对；（2）1989年国有农场（PGRs）的所有制转型是波兰大型农场形成的重要促进因素；（3）当前限制大型企业租赁国有土地的政策不利于农场结构优化，可能减少农业产出并引发农村社会动荡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为转型经济体中农场结构变化提供了实证案例，揭示了成本价格剪刀差与农场规模扩张之间的因果机制，丰富了农业结构调整理论在特殊制度变迁背景下的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波兰及类似转型国家的农业政策制定提供参考，警示限制大型农场发展的政策可能带来的经济与社会风险，建议在土地政策中平衡效率与公平。

title: Variation Trends of Air Quality and Pollution Characteristics in Baoji City from 2017 to 2025
affiliations: Shenyang University, Shenyang University, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) - Nanjing Institute of Geography and Limnology, Shenyang University, Shenyang University, Shenyang University and Shenyang University

detail.title: Variation Trends of Air Quality and Pollution Characteristics in Baoji City from 2017 to 2025
detail.abstract:
The Fenwei Plain is designated as one of China's three key regions for air pollution prevention and control, characterized by complex basin topography, unfavorable meteorological dispersion conditions, and a highly concentrated industrial structure. These factors collectively result in severe particulate matter pollution in autumn and winter and increasingly prominent photochemical ozone pollution in summer.

As a sub-central city located at the western end of the Fenwei Plain and a critical node on the regional pollution transmission channel, Baoji City epitomizes the conflict between heavy industrial development and aggressive clean-energy transformation under the national "dual-carbon" goals.

To reveal the long-term evolution law of air pollution in such a representative industrial city, this study systematically analyzed the interannual variation trends, spatial differentiation characteristics, and primary pollutant transformation in Baoji from 2017 to 2025. Based on continuous monitoring data from automatic ambient air monitoring stations across four districts and eight counties, six conventional atmospheric pollutants (SO₂, NO₂, CO, O₃, PM₂.₅, and PM₁₀) were evaluated using the Spearman rank correlation coefficient method.

The results demonstrated that the overall air quality improved significantly: five pollutants exhibited significant downward trends, whereas the 90th percentile of daily maximum 8-hour average O₃ (O₃-8h) showed a fluctuating upward trend. SO₂, NO₂, CO, and O₃ have continuously met the National Grade II Standard Limit since 2020, and PM₂.₅ achieved stable compliance from 2023 to 2025.

The dominant pollution type shifted from particulate matter-dominated pollution (PM₂.₅ + PM₁₀) in 2017 to composite pollution co-dominated by O₃ and PM₂.₅ in 2025. The proportion of O₃ as the primary pollutant increased from 15% in 2017 to 28% in 2025, becoming the main factor restricting further improvement.

Spatially, PM₂.₅ and PM₁₀ generally exhibited a distribution pattern with the lowest concentrations in the western mountainous areas and the highest in the central urban and eastern plain areas, with the regional concentration gradient continuously shrinking. In contrast, O₃ maintained a stable spatial pattern of high concentrations in the eastern plains and low concentrations in the southern mountainous areas, indicating prominent photochemical pollution prevention pressures in the main urban area and eastern districts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2017-2025年宝鸡市多站点大气污染物连续监测数据，系统分析了该典型工业城市空气污染的长期演变规律，发现空气质量总体显著改善，但臭氧污染日趋突出，污染类型正从PM主导型向PM与O₃复合型转变。
AI.research_question: 典型工业城市（宝鸡市）2017-2025年间空气污染的长期演变规律、空间分异特征及主导污染物转化趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 汾渭平原作为中国大气污染防治重点区域之一，其代表城市宝鸡面临重工业发展与清洁能源转型的矛盾。揭示此类城市空气污染的长周期演变规律，对指导区域精准治污和"双碳"目标下政策制定具有重要现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于大气污染时空演变理论、污染物转化规律、Spearman秩相关系数统计方法。
AI.method: 基于四区八县自动环境空气质量监测站的连续监测数据，采用Spearman秩相关系数法对SO₂、NO₂、CO、O₃、PM₂.₅、PM₁₀六项常规大气污染物进行评估，分析其年际变化趋势、空间差异及主导污染物转变。
AI.findings: （1）空气质量总体显著改善，五项污染物呈显著下降趋势，但O₃-8h第90百分位数呈波动上升；（2）SO₂、NO₂、CO、O₃自2020年持续达标，PM₂.₅于2023-2025年稳定达标；（3）主导污染类型从2017年的PM主导型转变为2025年的O₃与PM₂.₅复合型，O₃作为首要污染物的比例从15%升至28%；（4）空间上PM呈现西低东高格局且区域浓度梯度持续缩小，O₃呈现东高南低稳定格局。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了汾渭平原典型工业城市在"双碳"目标推进背景下空气质量改善的长周期规律，实证了污染类型从颗粒物主导向复合型演变的转型特征，为同类城市大气污染治理提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宝鸡市及汾渭平原地区大气污染防治政策的精准制定提供了数据支撑和科学依据；明确了O₃已成为制约空气质量进一步改善的关键因素，提示地方政府需加强夏季光化学污染协同治理。

title: Signaling Failures in Democratic Markets: Integrity, Voting Intention, and Information Asymmetry in Peru's 2026 Election
affiliations: Universidad Católica Argentina

detail.title: Signaling Failures in Democratic Markets: Integrity, Voting Intention, and Information Asymmetry in Peru's 2026 Election
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between candidate integrity and voting intention in Peru's 2026 presidential election. Using an original dataset of 35 candidates and a self-constructed binary integrity indexbuilt from open criminal cases and inconsistencies in mandatory asset declarations (declaraciones juradas)-I find a persistent negative correlation between integrity and vote share across four data points from three distinct sourcespreliminary data, two Ipsos surveys conducted 48 hours apart, and the official ONPE results: preliminary data (ρ =-0.28), Ipsos simulated vote April 1-2 (ρ =-0.33), Ipsos final poll April 3-4 (ρ =-0.31), and official ONPE election results (ρ =-0.36). Candidates classified as low integrity received on average 4.20% of the vote versus 0.96% for high-integrity candidates-4.4 times as many votes, a gap of 3.24 percentage points. This finding survives the inclusion of controls for ideological positioning, prior political trajectory, and digital visibility (OLS, N=30, R² = 0.47). I argue this counterintuitive finding does not reflect voter indifference to integrity, but rather a fundamental signaling failure in democratic markets: voters cannot efficiently discriminate between high-and low-integrity candidates. Drawing on Akerlof's (1970) framework of markets with hidden quality, Hayek's (1945) analysis of dispersed knowledge, and Cartwright's (1999) critique of rigour without mechanism, I reframe the problem as one of information architecture rather than preferences. I conclude with a falsifiable conjecture, in the spirit of Popper (1963), that artificial intelligence designed as democratic information infrastructure can function as credible signal infrastructure, restoring the electoral relevance of integrity.

AI.tldr: 本文发现秘鲁2026年大选中，低诚信候选人得票率反而是高诚信候选人的4.4倍，作者认为这并非选民不在乎诚信，而是民主市场存在信号失灵——选民无法有效区分候选人的真实诚信水平。
AI.research_question: 候选人诚信水平与选民投票意向之间存在何种关系？为何会出现"低诚信候选人反而获得更高得票率"这一反直觉现象？
AI.motivation: 传统民主理论假设选民会惩罚不诚信的候选人，但现实中屡见不鲜的"诚信悖论"表明这一假设可能不成立。作者希望从信息经济学角度解释这一现象，而非简单归因于选民道德冷漠。
AI.theoretical_framework: Akerlof（1970）"柠檬市场"理论（隐藏质量导致逆向选择）、Hayek（1945）分散知识理论、Cartwright（1999）对"有严谨性无机制"的批判、Popper（1963）可证伪性方法论。
AI.method: 构建二元诚信指数（基于公开刑事案件与财产申报不一致性），收集35名候选人数据，使用Spearman秩相关分析和OLS回归（N=30, R²=0.47），控制意识形态立场、政治轨迹和数字可见度等变量，数据来源涵盖初步数据、两次Ipsos民调及官方ONPE选举结果。
AI.findings: 四个数据点均显示诚信与得票率呈持续负相关（ρ=-0.28至-0.36）；低诚信候选人平均得票4.20%，高诚信候选人仅0.96%，差距达3.24个百分点（4.4倍）；该负相关在加入控制变量后依然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Akerlof的柠檬市场理论拓展至民主选举领域，提出"诚信信号失灵"概念；区分了选民偏好问题与信息架构问题，为政治学中的"信息不对称"研究提供了新的理论框架；提出将AI作为民主信息基础设施的可证伪假设，开辟了计算政治学的新方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了现有选举信息体系（民调、媒体报道等）无法有效传递候选人诚信信号的制度缺陷；为改革选举信息披露机制提供了实证基础；提出了利用AI技术作为"可信信号基础设施"的实践路径建议。

title: Keeping Up at the Planet's Expense: Longitudinal Evidence on Relative Concerns and Environmental Attitudes
affiliations: IZA Institute of Labor Economics and Turkish-German University

detail.title: Keeping Up at the Planet's Expense: Longitudinal Evidence on Relative Concerns and Environmental Attitudes
detail.abstract: The pressure to keep up with others may shift attention from environmental protection as a collective good toward private positional concerns. We study whether income comparisons are associated with environmental concern using the SocioEconomic Panel for 2000-2020. Individual fixed-effects linear probability models with rich reference-group definitions show that higher reference-group income is associated with a lower probability of reporting high environmental concern, while the own-income estimate is small in magnitude and statistically imprecise. A 10% increase in others' mean income corresponds to a decline of about 1-2% of the mean of environmental-protection or climate-change concern. The association is stronger among individuals with lower environmental awareness, lower patience, weaker prosocial orientation, and limited political engagement. It is also more pronounced in settings with higher pollution exposure and more intensive environmental-protection efforts, consistent with normalisation and morallicensing interpretations. The results are robust to nonlinear specifications, income-rank measures, median-based reference income, alternative comparison goods, and alternative referencegroup definitions. Overall, socioeconomic comparisons appear to be systematically related to environmental attitudes and offer policy-relevant insights for settings marked by rising inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国社会经济面板数据（2000-2020）发现，参考群体收入的增加会显著降低个体对环境保护和气候变化的关注度，而自身收入的影响不显著。这一效应在环保意识较低、耐心不足、亲社会倾向弱和政治参与有限的群体中更为突出，且在污染暴露更高、环保力度更大的环境中更加明显，支持了正常化和道德许可机制的解释。
AI.research_question: 收入比较（与他人的收入攀比）是否以及如何影响个体的环境关注度？
AI.motivation: 在收入不平等加剧的背景下，人们可能因攀比压力而从关注环境这一集体公共品转向私人的地位性关切，从而削弱环保意愿。该研究旨在揭示收入比较对环境态度的系统性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地位竞争理论、正常化效应（normalisation）、道德许可效应（moral licensing）
AI.method: 使用德国社会经济面板数据（SOEP 2000-2020），采用个体固定效应线性概率模型，并构建丰富的参考群体定义进行估计。
AI.findings: 1）参考群体收入每增加10%，个体报告高环境关注度的概率下降约1-2%；2）自身收入的影响不显著；3）该负向关联在环保意识低、耐心低、亲社会倾向弱、政治参与有限的人群中更强；4）在污染暴露高、环保力度大的环境中更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 将收入比较与社会地位竞争引入环境态度研究，为理解不平等如何通过社会比较机制侵蚀环保集体行动提供了理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者在设计环保政策时需考虑收入不平等与社会比较的负面效应，尤其是在不平等程度较高的环境中应警惕攀比压力对环保意识的削弱作用。

reference: Engage, Vol. 13(3), pp. 73-78, Federalist Society (October 2012)
title: The America Invents Act May be Constitutionally Infirm if It Repeals the Bar Against Patenting After Secret Commercial Use
affiliations: Bi-Level Technologies

detail.title: The America Invents Act May be Constitutionally Infirm if It Repeals the Bar Against Patenting After Secret Commercial Use
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the constitutionality of the new conditions for patentability set forth in the America Invents Act (AIA).  It poses the question whether the U.S. Constitution empowers Congress to grant patents to inventors on their inventions after they have had an unlimited period of exclusive commercial use of the invention and shows that such interpretation of the AIA as permitting such unlimited secret commercialization before filing for the patent would render the AIA unconstitutional.

AI.tldr: 本文分析《美国发明法案》（AIA）中可专利性新条件的合宪性，指出若解释为允许发明人在申请专利前进行无限期的秘密商业化，则该法案违宪。
AI.research_question: 美国宪法是否授权国会在发明人对其发明进行无限期独占性商业使用后仍授予其专利权？
AI.motivation: 探讨AIA中可专利性新条件的合宪性边界，防止专利制度被滥用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国宪法中的专利条款（Patent Clause）及宪法解释理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与宪法解释。
AI.findings: 若将AIA解释为允许无限期秘密商业化后再申请专利，则该法案违反美国宪法。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了专利条款中“促进科学和实用技艺进步”的宪法目的对专利授权的限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院解释AIA中可专利性条件提供了合宪性指引，防止专利制度偏离促进创新的初衷。

title: A Modest Legislative Proposal to Help Fix the College Football Schedule
affiliations: Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Business Law

detail.title: A Modest Legislative Proposal to Help Fix the College Football Schedule
detail.abstract:
College football coaches and administrators increasingly agree that their sport’s current calendar is “broken.” Following the recent expansion of the College Football Playoff (“CFP”) to a 12-team, championship tournament, the game’s post-season now consumes the better part of two months, stretching well into late-January. This protracted schedule has been blamed not only for distorting the competition on the field, but also for sapping fan interest and viewership from the season’s culminating matchups.

Unfortunately, no meaningful adjustment to the CFP schedule appears to be on the horizon, due in part to college officials’ desire to minimize any potential scheduling conflict with the National Football League (“NFL”). Due to an obscure statutory provision—the Sports Broadcasting Act of 1961 (“SBA”)—the NFL currently forgoes airing its games on Saturdays prior to the third weekend of December. This timeline has complicated the scheduling of the expanded CFP games, as college officials have sought to avoid scheduling their post-season games in direct head-to-head competition with the NFL on Saturdays in late December to the greatest extent possible.

Despite the statutory origin of this predicament, the existing discussion surrounding college football scheduling reform has largely overlooked the SBA as a potential means for fixing the sport’s calendar. Fortunately, the legislative origin of this dilemma also suggests a straightforward statutory solution. Because the SBA’s restriction preventing the NFL from playing on fall Saturdays was explicitly intended to protect college football, now that the latter’s season has crept well into January, the law should be amended to extend this protection accordingly. Such a fix would allow college officials to structure their post-season in the manner that best serves the sport, while continuing to preserve the traditional weekend dichotomy between college and professional football games throughout the sport’s full playing season.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了大学橄榄球赛程因CFP扩军至12队而变得"支离破碎"的问题，指出《体育广播法》（SBA）禁止NFL在圣诞节前的周六播放比赛的规定本是保护大学橄榄球，但如今大学赛季已延至1月，该法律应相应修订以延长保护期，从而解决赛程冲突。
AI.research_question: 如何通过修订《体育广播法》来解决大学橄榄球季后赛与NFL赛程冲突导致的赛程"支离破碎"问题？
AI.motivation: 大学橄榄球CFP扩军至12队后，季后赛延长至1月下旬，导致竞争扭曲、球迷兴趣和收视率下降，但相关讨论忽略了《体育广播法》这一法律工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律政策分析框架，特别是《体育广播法》（SBA）的立法意图解释及其对大学与职业橄榄球赛程安排的法律约束。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、立法意图分析、政策建议论证。
AI.findings: SBA限制NFL在12月第三个周末前的周六比赛，本意是保护大学橄榄球；但大学赛季延长后，该法律不再适用；通过修订SBA延长保护期，可给大学橄榄球更多赛程安排空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将《体育广播法》这一法律工具引入大学橄榄球赛程改革的讨论中，指出了现有政策讨论的盲点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学橄榄球赛程改革提供了可行的立法修订方案，建议延长SBA对大学橄榄球的保护期至整个赛季结束，从而解决CFP与NFL的赛程冲突。

title: Agent-Mediated Information Sharing for Anti-Money Laundering
affiliations: and Mastercard

detail.title: Agent-Mediated Information Sharing for Anti-Money Laundering
detail.abstract: Anti-money laundering investigations increasingly rely on AI-driven workflows, yet their effectiveness remains constrained by fragmented information sharing across financial institutions. While existing regulations permit collaboration, coordination in practice is largely manual and difficult to scale. This paper proposes an architecture for agent-mediated information sharing under Section 314(b) of the USA PATRIOT Act, combining agent-based design principles with open agent-to-agent communication protocols. We present communication topologies-bilateral exchange, case-scoped group coordination, and open signaling with conditional session formation-that preserve institutional autonomy, enforce purpose limitation and data minimization, and enable auditable, policy-controlled exchanges of investigative context. Using a distributed money mule investigation as a motivating example, we illustrate how these topologies allow institutions to surface overlapping investigative context without centralized data pooling or expanded regulatory risk. A reference implementation of the proposed topologies is provided as a companion to this paper. To our knowledge, this is the first architectural proposal applying open agent-to-agent communication protocols to inter-institutional information sharing under Section 314(b).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能体通信协议的架构，用于在《美国爱国者法案》第314(b)条框架下实现金融机构间反洗钱调查信息的去中心化、可审计共享，通过三种通信拓扑结构在保护机构自主性和数据最小化原则的同时，帮助识别重叠调查线索。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种架构，在遵守《美国爱国者法案》第314(b)条合规要求的前提下，实现金融机构间反洗钱调查信息的高效、可扩展且保护隐私的共享？
AI.motivation: 现有反洗钱调查中AI驱动的工作流虽然日益普及，但受限于金融机构间碎片化的信息共享。现有法规允许协作，但实际协调主要依赖人工操作，难以规模化，亟需一种自动化、可扩展的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于智能体的设计原则（Agent-Based Design Principles）；开放智能体间通信协议（Open Agent-to-Agent Communication Protocols）；信息共享中的目的限制与数据最小化原则（Purpose Limitation & Data Minimization）。
AI.method: 提出三种通信拓扑结构——双边交换、案件范围组协调、带条件会话形成的开放信号机制，并以分布式洗钱钱骡（Money Mule）调查为示例进行说明，同时提供了参考实现。
AI.findings: 三种通信拓扑能够在不进行集中式数据池化或扩大监管风险的前提下，让机构发现重叠的调查线索；架构保留了机构自主性，强制执行目的限制和数据最小化，并实现了可审计、策略可控的调查语境交换。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出将开放智能体间通信协议应用于美国《爱国者法案》第314(b)条下的机构间信息共享架构；为去中心化AML信息共享提供了理论上的通信拓扑分类与设计原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了三种可直接参考实现的通信拓扑结构；附带参考实现；为金融机构在合规前提下实现反洗钱协作信息共享提供了可行的工程架构方案。

reference: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2025-06
title: The Impact of Political and Economic Constraints on the Rare Earth Elements Market

detail.title: The Impact of Political and Economic Constraints on the Rare Earth Elements Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2025-06
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The issue of rare earth elements (REE) and the quest for a secure supply chain go beyond resource nationalism or export controls. They represent a form of time-limited strategic leverage within an evolving global system. China’s dominance in the REE market is significant but not permanent. Its durability depends on how other nations respond. The pace and trajectory of this shift will be shaped by global reactions to export restrictions, investment choices, and technological innovation.

This paper develops a three-period model to examine how China’s REE export strategy evolves under global political and economic constraints. These constraints reflect the observed trajectory of global political and economic reactions across three phases of shock, adjustment, and convergence. Understanding the structure of China’s leverage and the strategic timing of its use is crucial for anticipating the future of geoeconomic competition and the control of critical technologies. Moreover, this model allows us to assess a market where China is the dominant supplier and the rest of world reacts gradually and in fragmented fashion, with results highlighting why REE trade controls are more persistent and structurally dangerous.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个三期模型，分析中国稀土出口策略在全球政治经济约束下的演化，揭示稀土贸易控制为何具有持久性和结构性危险。
AI.research_question: 在全球政治与经济反应（冲击、调整、趋同三阶段）的约束下，中国稀土出口策略如何演化？稀土贸易控制为何具有持久性和结构性危险？
AI.motivation: 稀土供应链安全问题超越了资源民族主义或出口管制，代表了一种时间有限的战略杠杆。理解中国杠杆的结构及其战略时机，对预测地缘经济竞争和关键技术控制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三期博弈模型（冲击—调整—趋同），分析中国作为主导供应商、世界其他国家逐步且碎片化反应的动态博弈。
AI.method: 三时期理论模型构建，刻画全球政治经济约束下中国稀土出口策略的演化路径。
AI.findings: 中国稀土市场主导地位显著但非永久，其持久性取决于其他国家的响应方式。稀土贸易控制比预期更持久，且具有结构性危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将稀土出口策略置于时间维度的战略杠杆框架下分析，揭示了贸易控制在多期博弈中的持久性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解稀土供应链的地缘政治动态提供分析工具，提示关注出口限制、投资选择和技术创新对全球稀土市场格局的塑造作用。

title: Shaping the Future of Finance Education: Evidence from a National Survey of Australian Finance Academics
affiliations: , Monash Business School, Monash University, , Monash University, The University of Sydney, University of New South Wales (UNSW), University of Melbourne - Department of Finance and University of Melbourne - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Shaping the Future of Finance Education: Evidence from a National Survey of Australian Finance Academics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently under the Alliance of Finance Educators (AoFE) and received no external funding from commercial or industry sources. All authors are members of AoFE, no author received financial compensation for this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The project received human research ethics approval from the Monash University Human Research Ethics Committee (Project ID: 47743) for the conduct of the study and associated survey activities. Approval was subsequently ratified by the Human Research Ethics Committees at the home institutions of collaborating investigators, including the University of Melbourne, University of New South Wales, University of Queensland, University of Sydney, and the University of Technology Sydney.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The survey was conducted under the initiative of the Alliance of Finance Educators (AoFE), a network of Australian finance academics. All costs associated with the study were covered internally by the research team.

detail.abstract:
This paper reports findings from a national survey of finance academics across 28 Australian universities, conducted by the Alliance of Finance Educators (AoFE). The survey examines the conditions under which finance education is currently delivered, the challenges educators face, and the structural reforms they identify as necessary to sustain educational quality in a rapidly changing discipline.

The findings converge on four interconnected themes. First, student preparedness and engagement present growing challenges: critical thinking is identified as the most prevalent skill gap (71% of respondents), with over-reliance on artificial intelligence rated the single most acute student learning concern. Second, the institutional environment systematically obstructs effective teaching. Governance opacity, administrative burden, and ineffective leadership combine to produce conditions in which fewer than one in fourteen educators regard their faculty leadership as highly responsive to teaching staff concerns, and only half regard existing academic integrity policies as effective. Third, artificial intelligence has already substantially disrupted assessment practice, with 61% of respondents reporting changes to their assessment designs; yet only 18% describe their university's AI policies as clear and well-defined, against 81% who identify clear policy development as the most important institutional priority. Fourth, career progression frameworks systematically disadvantage teaching-focused academics: among this group, 45% disagree that career advancement is fair, compared to zero among research-focused colleagues, reflecting an institutional architecture experienced as equitable by those it rewards and inequitable by those it marginalises.

The paper advances targeted recommendations across governance, workload, assessment design, AI policy, and career framework reform, with implications for university administrators, disciplinary associations, and national higher education policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于对28所澳大利亚大学金融学者的全国调查，揭示了金融教育当前面临的四大挑战：学生批判性思维缺失与AI过度依赖、制度环境阻碍有效教学、AI政策模糊且评估体系被颠覆、以及教学型学者在晋升中遭受系统性不公。论文提出了治理、工作量、评估设计、AI政策和职业框架等方面的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚金融教育的现状如何？教育者面临哪些挑战？需要哪些结构性改革来维持教育质量？
AI.motivation: 金融学科正在快速变化（如AI的影响），但学界缺乏对教育交付条件、挑战和必要改革的大规模系统性了解。本研究试图填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究未明确依赖特定理论框架，而是基于实证调查数据归纳主题，属于探索性调查研究范式。
AI.method: 全国性问卷调查，覆盖28所澳大利亚大学，由澳大利亚金融教育联盟（AoFE）组织，对金融学术人员进行调查，数据通过描述性统计分析呈现。
AI.findings: 四个核心发现：（1）71%受访者认为批判性思维是最突出的技能缺口，AI过度依赖是最严重的学习问题；（2）制度环境系统性阻碍教学，只有不到1/14的教师认为院系领导对教学人员高度响应，仅半数认为学术诚信政策有效；（3）61%受访者已因AI改变评估设计，但仅18%认为所在大学AI政策清晰明确，81%认为制定清晰政策是最重要的优先事项；（4）45%的教学型学者认为晋升不公平，而研究型学者中这一比例为0%。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了澳大利亚金融教育在AI时代面临的制度性危机，为"教学-研究"二元体制中教学型学者边缘化提供了实证证据，拓展了对学术劳动力不平等问题的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了针对治理、工作量分配、评估改革、AI政策制定和职业框架改革的具体建议，对大学管理者、学科协会和国家高等教育政策制定具有直接指导意义。

title: Pricing of Continuously Monitored Bermudan Barrier Options via Recursive Static Replication
affiliations: University of Glasgow and University of Glasgow

detail.title: Pricing of Continuously Monitored Bermudan Barrier Options via Recursive Static Replication

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None of the authors has anything to declare.

detail.abstract: We study the valuation of continuously monitored Bermudan barrier options, a class of path-dependent derivatives combining discrete optimal stopping opportunities with continuously monitored barrier constraints. The interaction between continuous barrier monitoring and Bermudan exercise generates a non-trivial stopping problem, since the contract may be knocked out between two exercise opportunities, giving rise to a distinct intertemporal risk structure absent in standard Bermudan or American barrier contracts. The paper develops a recursive static replication framework for the pricing of such contracts under Black-Scholes dynamics. The method exploits the observation that, between consecutive Bermudan exercise dates, the contract reduces to a continuously monitored European-style barrier claim with a recursively updated terminal payoff. By approximating the continuation value through piecewiselinear static replication using vanilla option building blocks, the resulting continuation problem can be evaluated semi-analytically using closed-form barrier pricing formulas. We establish convergence and stability results for the recursive scheme and show that the associated continuation operator is a contraction in the sup norm. The proposed approach is benchmarked against a Least-Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) implementation with refined barrier monitoring. Numerical experiments demonstrate strong agreement between the two methods, while the static replication framework delivers accurate exercise boundaries, computational efficiency, and stable convergence behaviour across a wide range of parameter configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对连续监控的百慕大障碍期权，提出了一种基于分段线性静态复制的递归定价框架，在Black-Scholes模型下实现半解析定价，并证明了收敛性与稳定性。
AI.research_question: 如何对兼具连续障碍监控与百慕大式行权机会的路径依赖型衍生品进行有效定价？
AI.motivation: 连续障碍监控与百慕大式行权机会的交互产生了一种独特的跨期风险结构，该结构在标准百慕大或美式障碍合约中不存在，现有方法难以高效处理。
AI.theoretical_framework: Black-Scholes定价框架；递归静态复制方法；分段线性近似；压缩映射原理。
AI.method: 利用连续监控障碍合约在百慕大行权日之间可简化为具有递归更新终端收益的欧式障碍期权这一性质，采用香草期权构建分段线性静态复制以近似续值，进而利用闭式障碍定价公式进行半解析求解。
AI.findings: 递归方案在sup范数下具有压缩性，保证了收敛与稳定性；数值实验表明与LSM方法高度一致，且该方法在计算效率、行权边界精度和收敛行为方面表现优越。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为连续监控百慕大障碍期权建立了递归静态复制定价框架，并证明了其收敛性与稳定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种相比蒙特卡洛模拟更高效、更稳定的半解析定价方法，适用于各类参数配置下的实际定价与风险管理。

title: Fair Contribution System™: An Evidence-Based Incentive Allocation Model for Multi-Stakeholder Development Projects

detail.title: Fair Contribution System™: An Evidence-Based Incentive Allocation Model for Multi-Stakeholder Development Projects

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the Founder and Chief Architect of ENHANCE Institute, the organization that developed and holds intellectual property rights over the Fair Contribution System (FCS™) described in this paper. The author has a direct professional and financial interest in the adoption of FCS™. This interest is declared in the interest of transparency.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects research, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. All project documentation referenced is publicly available through the Green Climate Fund's public disclosure policy. Ethics approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author through ENHANCE Institute.

detail.abstract:
Climate mitigation and adaptation projects increasingly rely on multi-stakeholder structures in which design entities, executing agencies, supervision bodies, technical advisors, financiers, and local partners contribute different forms of expertise, effort, and risk management across a shared project lifecycle. This paper identifies incentive ambiguity — the structural absence of a principled mechanism for connecting measurable contribution to reward — as an under-theorized governance risk in multi-stakeholder climate and development projects.

Independent evaluations of climate finance institutions have already identified incentive-related weaknesses in project design, implementation support, and partnership structures. In the Green Climate Fund context, evaluation findings have noted that existing project appraisal and support structures may not sufficiently incentivize activities that build enabling environments, and that structures and incentives are needed to motivate countries, accredited entities, and the Secretariat to engage more effectively with national implementing partners.

Perceived contribution–reward misalignment does not primarily damage the project in which it occurs; it damages the ecosystem of future projects that the successful model could have replicated or scaled. A project that generates impact once, but fails to preserve the incentive conditions for repeated participation, may contribute to output-level success without contributing to paradigm shift.

This paper introduces the Fair Contribution System™ (FCS™), a role-constrained, evidence-based incentive allocation model for multi-stakeholder development projects. FCS™ separates two questions that are often conflated: how much total reward is assigned to a role group, and how that reward is distributed among individuals or entities performing the same role. By preserving role boundaries while measuring intra-role contribution, FCS™ avoids reward capture by hierarchy, institutional visibility, negotiation power, or subjective preference.

Within each role group, FCS™ evaluates contribution through five dimensions: Proactive Risk Reduction (PRR), Unexpected Risk Response (URR), Innovative Strategy Contribution (ISC), Resilience Gain (ΔR), and Substitution Index (SI). These dimensions recognize both visible delivery and less visible forms of value creation, including risk prevention, crisis response, structural innovation, recovery support, and irreplaceable expertise. Each contribution must be supported by verifiable evidence.

The contribution of this paper is threefold. First, it reframes incentive misalignment as a systemic risk to replication and scalability. Second, it presents a formal allocation architecture that separates role-based reward boundaries from evidence-based contribution measurement. Third, it shows how fair contribution allocation can be implemented within existing project governance structures without requiring institutional redesign.

Although FCS™ is developed in the context of climate and development finance, its logic applies wherever multiple actors contribute heterogeneous, partially observable, and difficult-to-contract forms of value to a shared outcome — including public–private partnerships, research consortia, ESG supply-chain initiatives, joint ventures, and private-sector innovation projects.

AI.tldr: 本文识别了多利益相关方气候项目中"激励模糊性"这一被忽视的治理风险，并提出公平贡献系统™（FCS™），一种基于角色边界与证据贡献分离的激励分配模型，旨在解决贡献与回报不对等对项目可复制性和规模化的系统性损害。
AI.research_question: 在多利益相关方的气候减缓与适应项目中，激励模糊性如何成为一种系统性治理风险？如何设计一种公平、可验证的贡献-回报匹配机制来避免这种风险？
AI.motivation: 现有气候金融独立评估已发现激励相关缺陷，但"激励模糊性"作为结构性治理风险尚未得到充分理论化。贡献-回报错位不仅损害当前项目，更破坏未来项目的可复制和规模化生态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励模糊性（Incentive Ambiguity）、贡献-回报错位（Contribution–Reward Misalignment）、角色约束的激励分配模型、范式转移（Paradigm Shift）
AI.method: 概念性的理论建构与机制设计：提出FCS™五维度贡献评估体系（PRR, URR, ISC, ΔR, SI），分离"角色群体总回报"与"个体间回报分配"两个问题。
AI.findings: （1）激励模糊性是系统性风险，主要损害项目的可复制性和规模化生态而非项目本身；（2）FCS™通过角色边界+证据贡献测量避免了层级、可见度、谈判权力对回报的捕获；（3）FCS™可在现有治理结构中实施，无需制度重组。
AI.theory_contributions: 将激励错位重新框定为对可复制性和规模化的系统性风险；提出了分离角色回报边界与证据贡献测量的正式分配架构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为多利益相关方项目（气候金融、PPP、研究联盟、ESG供应链、合资企业等）提供了可实施的公平激励分配模型；明确了五维可验证贡献指标。

title: Adopt or Be Undercut: The Structural Inevitability of Business AI

detail.title: Adopt or Be Undercut: The Structural Inevitability of Business AI
detail.abstract: The dominant framing treats AI adoption in listed firms and public bodies as a strategic choice. Under two pressures operating sequentially — directors’ duty to deliver economic efficiency, and the cost-benchmark cut imposed by peer firms’ AI deployment — adoption becomes a fiduciary baseline that competitive selection progressively enforces. Three operational architectures emerge (non-adopter, augmenter, AI-native), with three dynamics selecting among them (augmenter trap, AI-native trajectory, non-adopter exit). Sectoral vignettes from UK judicial AI, content-distribution disruption, and knowledge-service augmentation-and-displacement illustrate the trajectory. AI-native architecture becomes the conditional equilibrium under specified conditions; what to do about it is a separate question.

title: Generative AI and B2B Communication: Signals in First-Touch Outbound Email Outreach

detail.title: Generative AI and B2B Communication: Signals in First-Touch Outbound Email Outreach

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial conflicts of interest. This paper was adapted from an undergraduate thesis and draws on anonymized outreach material and interview data. No organization influenced the analysis, interpretation, or conclusions of the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No formal ethics approval was obtained for this undergraduate thesis study. Interviews were conducted voluntarily for academic research purposes, and the paper reports only anonymized and non-identifying information. Campaign materials were anonymized and presented at an aggregate or campaign-label level.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how AI-authored and human-authored first-touch B2B outreach emails differ in the signals they send and how those differences are associated with early-stage engagement outcomes. The focus is on first-touch outreach because an unfamiliar business sender contacts a potential customer before trust exists, so the message itself becomes the basis for judgment. Using ten campaigns and five interviews, this study compares four signal dimensions: credibility, relevance, authenticity or human signal, and automation-like signal. The findings show that AI-authored emails were often stronger on structured credibility, while human-authored emails more often showed stronger relevance, stronger authenticity, and more visible contextual adjustment. The main point is that, in first-touch outreach, polish alone is not enough. The message must also make the sender appear legitimate, relevant, and worth engaging.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在B2B首次联系外联邮件中，AI撰写与人类撰写的邮件在信号传递上的差异，以及这些差异如何影响早期互动结果。研究发现AI邮件在结构化可信度上更强，而人类邮件在相关性、真实性和上下文调整上更优，说明在首次外联中仅靠"打磨"不足以保证效果。
AI.research_question: AI撰写与人类撰写的B2B首次联系外联邮件在信号传递上有何差异？这些差异如何影响早期互动结果？
AI.motivation: B2B首次联系外联中，寄件人与收件人尚未建立信任关系，邮件本身成为判断依据。随着AI文本生成技术的普及，了解AI邮件与人类邮件在信号传递上的差异及其对互动效果的影响，对于优化B2B销售沟通策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Signaling Theory）；可信度、相关性、真实性/人类信号、类自动化信号四个信号维度。
AI.method: 基于十个外联活动（campaigns）的实证数据与五次访谈的定性分析，采用比较研究方法，对比AI撰写与人类撰写邮件在四个信号维度上的表现。
AI.findings: AI撰写邮件在结构化可信度上表现更强；人类撰写邮件在相关性、真实性和上下文调整方面更优。在首次外联中，仅靠邮件的"打磨"（polish）不足以获得积极回应，还需让收件人感知到寄件人的合法性、相关性和互动价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号理论应用于AI与人类撰写B2B外联邮件的比较研究，提出了四个信号维度的分析框架，揭示了AI文本在首次接触场景中的信号局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为B2B销售和市场营销人员提供了邮件撰写策略指导：在首次外联中不应过度依赖AI生成内容，需关注邮件的相关性、真实性和个性化上下文调整，以提升潜在客户的回应率。

title: Behavioural Drivers of Smallholder Farmers’ Intention to Adopt Maize-Legume Intercropping in Mbeya District, Tanzania
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and International Institute of Tropical Agriculture

detail.title: Behavioural Drivers of Smallholder Farmers’ Intention to Adopt Maize-Legume Intercropping in Mbeya District, Tanzania
detail.abstract: Maize-legume intercropping offers important ecological and economic benefits for smallholder farming systems, yet its adoption remains limited across many parts of Sub-Saharan Africa. This study examined behavioural factors influencing farmers’ intention to adopt maize-legume intercropping in Mbeya District, Tanzania, using an Extended Theory of Planned Behaviour (ETPB) framework. The model extends the conventional framework by incorporating knowledge, Innovativeness, and perceived attributes of the technology to better explain adoption under resource constraints and limited access to information. Data were collected from 329 smallholder farmers using a structured questionnaire and analysed through Structural Equation Modelling (SEM). Results showed that subjective norms (β = 0.513, p < 0.001) and knowledge (β = 0.208, p < 0.003) significantly and positively influence farmers’ intention to adopt maize-legume intercropping, while attitudes (β = 0.089, p = 0.155) and perceived behavioural control (β = 0.051, p = 0.436) had no significant direct effects. Knowledge exerted significant positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioural control, and perceived attributes of intercropping, underscoring its central role in linking innovativeness and technology perceptions to adoption intention. Overall, the model explained 44.7% of the variance in adoption intention. This study contributes by empirically extending the Theory of Planned Behaviour in a smallholder context, demonstrating that adoption intention for maize-legume intercropping is primarily socially and knowledge driven. The findings provide policy insights for strengthening farmer learning systems, extension services, and social networks that facilitate sustainable agricultural intensification and contribute to United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 2 (Zero Hunger).

AI.tldr: 本研究基于扩展的计划行为理论（ETPB），以坦桑尼亚姆贝亚地区329位小农户为样本，采用结构方程模型（SEM）分析发现，主观规范和知识显著正向影响农户采用玉米-豆科间作系统的意愿，而态度和知觉行为控制无显著直接影响。该模型解释了44.7%的采纳意愿变异，表明小农的农业技术采纳主要受社会规范与知识驱动。
AI.research_question: 哪些行为因素影响坦桑尼亚小农户采用玉米-豆科间作系统的意愿？
AI.motivation: 玉米-豆科间作在撒哈拉以南非洲具有重要的生态和经济效益，但实际采用率仍然有限。现有研究对资源受限、信息获取有限的小农户情境下，行为因素如何影响间作技术采纳缺乏深入实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展的计划行为理论（Extended Theory of Planned Behaviour, ETPB），在经典TPB（态度、主观规范、知觉行为控制）基础上增加知识、创新性和技术感知属性三个变量。
AI.method: 采用结构化问卷收集329位小农户数据，运用结构方程模型（SEM）进行假设检验与路径分析。
AI.findings: （1）主观规范（β=0.513, p<0.001）和知识（β=0.208, p<0.003）显著正向影响采纳意愿；（2）态度和知觉行为控制的直接效应不显著；（3）知识对态度、知觉行为控制和技术感知属性均有显著正向影响；（4）模型整体解释力为44.7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 在小农情境下经验性地扩展了计划行为理论，揭示了在资源约束和信息受限条件下，知识和社会规范而非个人态度或控制感是采纳意愿的主要驱动因素，为TPB在发展中国家农业技术采纳领域的适用性提供了修正见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供依据：应加强农民学习系统、推广服务和社交网络建设，以促进可持续农业集约化，助力实现联合国可持续发展目标2（零饥饿）。

title: Is AI Talk Cheap? Evidence from Earnings Conference Calls
affiliations: Bangor Business School and

detail.title: Is AI Talk Cheap? Evidence from Earnings Conference Calls
detail.abstract: We examine how equity markets price firm disclosure about a novel technology when its salience shifts discretely, exploiting the release of ChatGPT in November 2022. From 229,711 earnings call transcripts over 2007-2025, we construct firm-level measures of AI mention frequency, local AI risk, and local AI sentiment in the Q&A section. A one-standard-deviation increase in AI mention frequency between consecutive calls associates with around a nine basis point higher announcement-window abnormal return in the pre-release global sample, but that substantially attenuates after the release of ChatGPT. The AI-mention premium declines both at the population level and within the subset of firms with an established AI track record, consistent with cheap-talk dilution. Two textual features of AI talk that were unpriced before the fall of 2022 then enter the market reaction: positive AI-adjacent sentiment is associated with higher returns, and local AI risk language with lower returns. In the US sample, investors respond more strongly to AI risk warnings from firms with established AI track records, while sentiment is priced similarly across firms. Outside the US, AI risk disclosures are priced much more strongly for EU firms after the release, while AI sentiment is priced more strongly for Asian firms.

AI.tldr: 利用2022年11月ChatGPT发布作为外生冲击，研究发现企业在财报电话会中提及AI的频率带来的正异常回报在ChatGPT发布后大幅减弱，而AI相关情感和风险语言则开始被市场定价。
AI.research_question: 当一项新兴技术的显著性发生离散性变化时，股票市场如何对企业关于该技术的披露进行定价？具体为ChatGPT发布前后，市场对企业财报电话会中AI相关讨论的定价如何变化。
AI.motivation: 人工智能技术重要性激增（ChatGPT发布为外生冲击），但市场如何对企业层面的AI披露进行定价尚不明确，特别是当一项技术从相对小众变为广泛关注时，市场定价机制如何演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、信号传递理论、廉价谈话（cheap talk）理论、投资者注意力分配理论
AI.method: 基于229,711份财报电话会记录（2007-2025年），构建企业层面AI提及频率、局部AI风险、局部AI情感三个文本指标；采用事件研究法，比较ChatGPT发布前后市场异常回报的变化，并进行横截面分析。
AI.findings: 1) ChatGPT发布前，AI提及频率每增加一个标准差，公告窗口异常回报约高9个基点；2) ChatGPT发布后，该溢价显著减弱，且在已有AI基础的企业子样本中也成立，符合廉价谈话稀释解释；3) ChatGPT发布前未被定价的AI情感和AI风险语言在发布后开始被市场定价（正面情感对应高回报，风险语言对应低回报）；4) 美国市场对AI企业的风险警告反应更强；5) 欧盟企业AI风险披露定价更强，亚洲企业AI情感定价更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新技术显著性变化如何改变市场对企业披露的定价机制，验证了廉价谈话理论在新技术披露背景下的适用性，丰富了市场效率与投资者注意力分配相关理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解AI相关披露的市场定价提供实证依据，为企业管理者在技术变革时期的信息披露策略提供参考，为监管机构理解市场对新兴技术披露的反应机制提供洞察。

title: Designing Royalty Contracts in Retail Concessions: An Efficiency-Fairness Trade-off

detail.title: Designing Royalty Contracts in Retail Concessions: An Efficiency-Fairness Trade-off

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known of any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and mathematical analysis that does not involve any human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper studies royalty contract design in retail concessions under sales uncertainty. The operator chooses a price; the landlord receives revenue through a nonlinear royalty schedule contracted ex ante. Uncertainty relaxes the incentive constraint: pricing depends on the expected marginal distortion rather than its pointwise realization, enlarging the class of efficientimplementing contracts. We characterize the optimal contract under an efficiency-fairness tradeoff, treating fairness as an exogenous social objective rather than a preference of either party. The optimal schedule takes a shifted-hyperbolic form, augmented by a density-score correction.

AI.tldr: 研究销售不确定性下零售专柜的特许权合同设计，发现不确定性会放松激励约束，最优合同呈移位的双曲线形式，并加入密度分数校正，体现了效率与公平的权衡。
AI.research_question: 在销售不确定性下，运营商如何设计非线性特许权使用费合同？最优合同的形式是什么？
AI.motivation: 零售专柜中，运营商（租户）选择价格，房东通过事前签订的非线性特许权使用费获得收入。销售不确定性会影响激励约束，需要研究如何设计最优合同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合同理论、激励理论、效率-公平权衡框架
AI.method: 理论建模，分析非线性特许权使用费合同在销售不确定性下的最优设计
AI.findings: 不确定性放松了激励约束，定价取决于预期边际扭曲而非逐点实现；最优合同呈移位的双曲线形式，并加入密度分数校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不确定性如何影响激励约束和合同设计，扩展了可有效实施的合同类别；将公平作为外生社会目标纳入效率-公平权衡分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售专柜中的特许权使用费合同设计提供了理论指导，有助于房东和运营商在销售不确定性下制定更优的合同条款。

title: Unintended Consequences of Corporate Overtime: Spillover Effects on Consumer Voice
affiliations: Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, Keele University - Keele Business School and Florida Atlantic University

detail.title: Unintended Consequences of Corporate Overtime: Spillover Effects on Consumer Voice
detail.abstract: Consumer complaints incorporate consumers in value co-creation with firms. As a pivotal HRM practice, the spillover effects of corporate overtime on consumer feedback warrant rigorous investigation. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2018 to 2023, this study constructs a firm-level overtime indicator based on daily satellite nighttime light data and machine learning methods, and analyses over 16 million consumer complaint behaviors. Drawing on the organizational slack theory and job demand control theory, the findings indicate that corporate overtime significantly increases consumer online complaints, mediated primarily through weakened firm-employee relationship and compromised product quality management. Under the ability-motivation-opportunity framework, we demonstrate that employee training (ability), female core employees (motivation), and employee engagement (opportunity) effectively mitigate the adverse effects of overtime. From the perspective of labor-product market interaction, this study deepens our understanding of the literature on firms' intangible slack resources, employee strain, and consumer voice.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2018-2023年中国A股上市公司数据，利用卫星夜间灯光数据和机器学习方法构建企业加班指标，分析超过1600万条消费者投诉行为，发现企业加班显著增加消费者在线投诉，其机制在于削弱员工-企业关系和降低产品质量管理，而员工培训、女性核心员工和员工参与能有效缓解加班的不利影响。
AI.research_question: 企业加班行为如何影响消费者在线投诉？其内在机制和调节因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 消费者投诉是消费者与企业价值共创的重要环节，而加班作为关键人力资源管理实践，其溢出效应对消费者反馈的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织松弛理论、工作需求-控制理论、能力-动机-机会（AMO）框架
AI.method: 以2018-2023年中国A股上市公司为样本，基于卫星夜间灯光数据和机器学习方法构建企业层面加班指标，分析超过1600万条消费者投诉行为数据。
AI.findings: 企业加班显著增加消费者在线投诉；机制路径为削弱员工-企业关系和降低产品质量管理；员工培训、女性核心员工和员工参与能有效缓解加班对消费者投诉的负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 从劳动-产品市场互动的视角，深化了对企业无形松弛资源、员工压力及消费者声音文献的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了缓解加班负面效应的人力资源管理策略（如培训、女性核心员工配置和员工参与），有助于改善消费者反馈和提升企业绩效。

title: Confidants, Comrades, or Constituents: When Relational Misclassification Costs More Than You Know

detail.title: Confidants, Comrades, or Constituents: When Relational Misclassification Costs More Than You Know

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This brief presents conceptual frameworks and does not involve human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This essay introduces relational misclassification as a governing mechanism in organizational life -- the systematic extension of confidant-level trust, candor, and vulnerability into relationships that are, by their nature and governing conditions, constituent or comrade in structure. Drawing on a relational taxonomy distinguishing confidants, comrades, and constituents -- extended here into organizational behavior and culture theory -- the essay argues that what professionals most often experience as betrayal during organizational pressure points -- layoffs, restructurings, leadership transitions -- is more precisely the collapse of a misclassified relationship.

The structure did not break. It revealed itself.

The essay introduces relational silence as an original construct (Adams-Qualtiere, 2026): the withholding of candor, dissent, or genuine perspective based on accurate perception that the relationship one occupies does not authorize it. Relational silence is distinguished from the three existing silence typologies identified by Van Dyne, Ang, and Botero (2003) -- acquiescent, defensive, and prosocial -- as a fourth, diagnostic form of silence rooted not in resignation, fear, or altruism but in accurate relational reading.

The essay examines relational misclassification at three levels: the separated employee who carries a misdiagnosis of betrayal, the manager whose positional obligations foreclose the confidant relationship they believed they occupied, and the survivor staff whose rapid relational recalibration following a workforce reduction produces the organizational silence Morrison and Milliken (2000) identify as a barrier to change. Across all three, the essay applies the constructs of positional aggression, discursive distancing, conditional developmental belonging, and developmental compression (Adams-Qualtiere) to argue that relational misclassification is not a failure of individual perception. It is an organizational production.

The essay closes with a framework for relational clarity as a leadership discipline, drawing on the Quiet Authority construct developed across the founding trilogy of The Path to Quiet Authority series, and names the organizational accountability that individual discernment alone cannot substitute for.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"关系误分类"概念，指在组织生活中将本应是"同僚"或"成员"的关系错误地当作"密友"来经营。当组织压力事件（裁员、重组等）发生时，人们体验到的"背叛"其实是关系误分类的崩塌——结构并未断裂，而是显现了本来面目。文章还提出了"关系沉默"这一新构念，并分析了关系误分类在离职员工、管理者和幸存员工三个层面的表现，指出这并非个体感知偏差，而是组织系统性的产物。
AI.research_question: 组织生活中的"背叛"体验是否实质上是关系误分类（relational misclassification）的产物？组织如何系统地制造这种误分类？
AI.motivation: 解释组织压力点（如裁员、重组、领导层更替）下专业人士普遍经历的"背叛"感的真实来源，揭示其并非关系断裂，而是关系本质的暴露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系分类学（密友/同僚/成员）、关系沉默（第四种沉默类型，区别于Van Dyne等的三种沉默）、定位性攻击、话语疏离、条件性发展归属、发展压缩等构念。
AI.method: 概念性论文（essay），通过理论构建和概念推演，结合组织行为与文化理论进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）关系误分类是组织系统性地生产出来的，而非个体感知偏差；（2）"背叛"实质上是误分类关系的真相显露；（3）关系沉默基于对关系类型准确感知的沉默，不同于屈从、防御或亲社会型沉默；（4）关系误分类在离职员工、管理者和幸存员工三个层面均有不同表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"关系误分类"作为组织中一种治理机制；提出了"关系沉默"作为第四种沉默类型；将关系分类学引入组织行为与文化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"关系清晰度"作为领导力修炼的框架，借鉴"安静权威"构念；指出了组织层面的责任不能仅靠个体辨别力来替代。

title: Agent-Based Negotiation For Intermodal Transportation Services With Hybrid Collaborative And Knowledge-Based Recommendations

detail.title: Agent-Based Negotiation For Intermodal Transportation Services With Hybrid Collaborative And Knowledge-Based Recommendations
detail.abstract: The increasing complexity of modern supply chains, characterized by multimodal freight movements and a growing number of stakeholders with divergent objectives, necessitates intelligent decisionsupport systems capable of managing both the operational and transactional dimensions of transportation. This research presents a novel framework for agent-based negotiation in intermodal transportation services that integrates hybrid collaborative and knowledge-based recommendation mechanisms to enhance the efficiency, adaptability, and user satisfaction of freight booking and routing processes. The work builds upon foundational concepts in web-based transportation systems, where intelligent agents have been employed to automate the discovery, comparison, and selection of transportation services, while also addressing persistent challenges such as information overload, preference elicitation, and the dynamic nature of transportation markets. The proposed system architecture comprises a multi-agent platform in which specialized software agents represent distinct stakeholders, including shippers, carriers, and logistics intermediaries. Each agent is endowed with a set of goals, constraints, and negotiation strategies that reflect the economic and operational priorities of its human counterpart. The negotiation process is structured as a series of alternating offers and counteroffers over multiple attributes, including price, transit time, reliability, and environmental impact, thereby enabling the exploration of Pareto-optimal solutions that balance competing interests. A critical innovation of this framework lies in its integration of hybrid recommendation techniques that operate across two complementary dimensions: collaborative filtering and knowledge-based reasoning. The collaborative component leverages historical transaction data and user behavior patterns to identify similar negotiation scenarios and recommend service configurations that have proven satisfactory in analogous contexts. This approach is particularly valuable in situations where explicit preference information is sparse or ambiguous, as it allows the system to infer latent preferences from the collective experience of the user community. The knowledge-based component, in contrast, encodes domain-specific rules and constraints derived from transportation regulations, carrier capabilities, and logistical best practices. This rule engine filters out infeasible or suboptimal options before negotiation begins, reducing the search space and accelerating convergence toward mutually acceptable agreements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向多式联运服务的智能体协商框架，该框架融合了混合协同过滤与知识推理的推荐机制，旨在提升货运预订和路线规划的效率、适应性与用户满意度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个集成混合推荐机制的智能体协商框架，以有效管理多式联运运输服务中多个利益相关者的复杂博弈与决策问题？
AI.motivation: 现代供应链日益复杂，多式联运涉及大量目标各异的利益相关者，现有决策支持系统在应对信息过载、偏好获取困难以及运输市场的动态性方面存在不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多智能体系统理论、协商博弈理论、协同过滤推荐技术、知识推理引擎、帕累托最优均衡理论。
AI.method: 提出一个包含托运人、承运人、物流中介等多智能体平台架构，通过交替报价的多属性协商机制（涵盖价格、运输时间、可靠性、环境影响等），并集成协同过滤（基于历史交易与用户行为）与知识推理（基于领域规则与约束）的混合推荐方法。
AI.findings: 混合推荐机制能够有效处理用户偏好稀疏问题，通过协同过滤推断潜在偏好；知识推理模块可过滤不可行方案、缩小搜索空间，加速协商收敛至双方可接受的帕累托最优解。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将协同过滤与知识推理两种互补的推荐范式系统性地整合到多式联运智能体协商框架中，拓展了多智能体系统在运输服务领域的理论应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货运预订与路线规划提供了一套智能、自适应且用户友好的决策支持工具，有助于提升多式联运中多方博弈的谈判效率与最终满意度。

title: The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol: Phase A Pivot-Validation Specification (v1.3)

detail.title: The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol: Phase A Pivot-Validation Specification (v1.3)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed full-time at Samsung Electronics America (Director, Corporate Brand Creative and Governance). The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol and the broader Third System programme are independent research conducted under the SVA MPS Branding Program affiliation and the Third System research entity. Samsung Electronics America did not commission, fund, or review this research. No Samsung products are measured in any AIAS programme phase to date; Samsung is not represented in any published or in-pipeline brand panel. The author declares no other competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; no human subjects. Data collection uses public Google Trends API (via SerpAPI) and public LLM API endpoints under standard developer terms of service.
declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded. No external research funding or sponsorship.

detail.abstract: The AIAS Presence Measurement Protocol (v1.2; SSRN 6761698) specified Phase A pivot validation as the step that establishes a brand's substrate-category fit before Phase B topic-ID resolution proceeds, but documented the validation at the level of intent only — the specific stages, thresholds, and contingency-handling rules used in operational practice were not centrally specified. v0.16 (kitchen knives; SSRN 6791999) surfaced the gap operationally: the pre-registered pivot Victorinox failed Phase A on canonical-query Trends eligibility, and the activated alternate Wüsthof failed all three numeric stages of the same protocol, yet was activated as the operational pivot under pre-reg §6 contingency through manual operator intervention. This methodological note specifies the Phase A pivot-validation procedure centrally. §6.4 formalizes the five-stage protocol used in practice: Stage 1 (Knowledge Graph entity-suggestion audit for the pivot brand), Stage 2 (baseline Trends stability check), Stage 3 (bundle position check against in-category reference brands), Stage 4 (adjacency check against the pre-registered substrate-vs-adjacent keyword pair), Stage 5 (verdict aggregation under stage-conjunction thresholds on Stages 2–4). The fallback activation rule (R_F) implements bounded override: when both the primary pivot and the activated alternate fail Stage 5, the operator may invoke a one-time bounded override per cell per phase with mandatory DEVIATIONS log entry. The v0.16 Victorinox/Wüsthof case is retrospectively scored against the v1.3 specification in §6.4.8. v1.3 is a v1.2 successor increment; §6.4 is added, all other Protocol v1.2 sections remain byte-identical.

AI.tldr: 本文正式定义了AIAS存在感测量协议v1.3中Phase A pivot验证的五阶段操作流程，填补了v1.2仅记录意图而未规定具体阶段、阈值和应急处理规则的空白，并回溯评估了v0.16厨房刀具案例中Victorinox/Wüsthof的验证失败与操作员手动干预问题。
AI.research_question: 如何将AIAS存在感测量协议v1.2中仅记录意图的Phase A pivot验证，形式化为具有可操作的具体阶段、阈值和应急处理规则的中心化验证程序？
AI.motivation: v0.16厨房刀具案例暴露了v1.2协议的缺陷：预注册的Victorinox在Phase A因Google Trends资格问题失败，替代品牌Wüsthof也未能通过所有三阶段数值验证，却依据预注册§6的应急条款通过人工操作被激活为有效pivot。这说明缺少中央规范的验证程序会导致操作歧义和偶然性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: AIAS存在感测量协议的结构化验证方法、Google Trends数据稳定性和基准性验证、知识图谱实体审计、品牌与品类匹配的层次化验证框架。
AI.method: 协议修正与形式化规范：提出五阶段验证流程（Stage 1: 知识图谱实体建议审计；Stage 2: 基准Trends稳定性检查；Stage 3: 品类内参考品牌的束位置检查；Stage 4: 预注册基质-邻近关键词对的邻近性检查；Stage 5: 基于Stage 2-4的阶段合取阈值的裁决汇总）。同时引入降级激活规则（R_F），允许在主要pivot和激活的替代pivot均未通过Stage 5时，操作员执行每细胞每相位一次的有界覆盖，并强制记录DEVIATIONS日志条目。
AI.findings: v1.3协议对v0.16案例的回溯评分显示，Victorinox/Wüsthof案例中的操作员手动干预符合新定义的R_F降级激活规则，但此前缺乏正式记录。v1.3是v1.2的增量改进，仅新增§6.4，其余部分字节不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AIAS存在感测量协议提供了可复制、可审计的pivot验证理论框架，填补了从意图声明到操作规范之间的理论空白，建立了多阶段合取验证与有界操作员覆盖的混合验证模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用AIAS协议的研究者提供了明确、可操作的Phase A pivot验证操作指南，通过DEVIATIONS日志机制增强了研究的可审计性和透明度，减少了因操作员判断差异导致的协议偏差。

reference: CESifo Working Paper No. 12690
title: Determinants of Tobacco Tax Noncompliance: Evidence Among German Smokers
affiliations: and Johannes Kepler University Linz - Department of Economics

detail.title: Determinants of Tobacco Tax Noncompliance: Evidence Among German Smokers

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using a conducted survey for Germany allows us to evaluate the access to illicit tobacco products and the propensity to engage in illicit purchasing behavior. By separating realized opportunities from stated openness toward future illicit purchases, the analysis provides new insights into the behavioral foundations of illicit tobacco markets. Understanding these mechanisms is particularly relevant in the current policy context. If illicit demand responds not only to prices but also to attitudes toward taxation and regulation, further tax increases may have heterogeneous effects across population groups. Overall, the findings suggest that effective tobacco tax policy should not be based solely on price incentives. Where regulation is perceived as a restriction of freedom, the risk of openness in the illicit market may increase.

AI.tldr: 本文通过德国调查数据，区分了实际参与和未来意愿两个维度，分析了人们购买非法烟草产品的行为基础，发现对税收和监管的态度比价格更能影响非法购买倾向。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素驱动人们购买非法烟草产品？价格因素与态度因素（对税收和监管的态度）分别如何影响实际非法购买行为和未来非法购买意愿？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注价格对非法烟草需求的影响，但忽略了人们对税收和监管的态度可能同样重要。在政策层面，如果进一步增加烟草税对不同群体产生异质性效果，理解这些行为机制尤为关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学视角下的非法市场参与理论；区分实际行为（已实现的非法购买机会）与行为意愿（对未来的开放性）的分析框架。
AI.method: 基于德国调查数据，采用定量分析方法，区分已发生的非法购买行为与对未来非法购买的态度/开放性。
AI.findings: 非法烟草需求不仅受价格影响，还受人们对税收和监管的态度影响。当监管被视为对自由的限制时，人们对非法市场的开放性可能增加。进一步加税可能在不同人群中产生异质性效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了实际非法购买行为与未来非法购买意愿两个维度，为理解非法烟草市场的"行为基础"提供了新视角；揭示了态度因素（而非仅价格因素）在非法需求中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为烟草税收政策提供了新启示：有效的烟草税政策不能仅基于价格激励，还需考虑公众对监管合法性的感知；政策制定者应注意加税可能在某些群体中反而增加非法市场参与风险。

reference: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-29
title: Interchange Fees in Payment Networks Implications for Prices, Profits, and Welfare
affiliations: Consumer Finance Institute, Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia,  and Drexel University

detail.title: Interchange Fees in Payment Networks Implications for Prices, Profits, and Welfare

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Philadelphia Working Paper No. 26-29
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a two-sided model of the payment card market with elastic consumer demand, merchant and network market power, ad valorem interchange fees, cardholder rewards and cash as an alternative payment method. Drawing on insights from public finance, we define a credit card tax—an endogenous wedge between consumer and merchant prices generated by interchange fees, rewards, and credit card adoption. We show how this tax affects equilibrium prices, platform profits and welfare. Our analysis yields a novel and policy-relevant result: Contrary to conventional wisdom, capping interchange fees can increase equilibrium rewards when consumer demand is relatively inelastic. This, in turn, raises credit card adoption and intensifies cross-subsidization, benefiting card users, potentially at the expense of cash users. By contrast, when demand is more elastic, fee caps reduce rewards and card usage, improving outcomes for both groups. We also characterize the conditions under which interchange fee caps enhance allocative efficiency and encourage socially desirable payment choices. Overall, the paper offers new theoretical insights into the regulation of two-sided payment markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了包含弹性消费者需求、商户和网络市场势力、从价交换费、持卡人奖励和现金替代支付方式的支付卡市场双边模型，揭示了"信用卡税"机制，并发现交换费上限在需求缺乏弹性时反而可能提高奖励水平和信用卡采纳率，颠覆了传统认知。
AI.research_question: 支付卡市场中，交换费上限如何影响均衡奖励水平、信用卡采纳率、交叉补贴及不同群体（持卡人与现金用户）的福利？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为交换费上限会降低持卡人奖励，但这一结论可能不适用于所有市场条件。本文旨在从公共财政视角出发，系统分析交换费监管在不同需求弹性条件下的差异化效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、公共财政理论（税收楔子概念）、市场势力与定价理论
AI.method: 构建双边市场理论模型，纳入弹性消费者需求、商户与网络市场势力、从价交换费、持卡人奖励和现金支付选项，进行均衡分析和比较静态分析。
AI.findings: (1)定义了"信用卡税"——由交换费、奖励和信用卡采纳产生的消费者价格与商户价格之间的内生楔子；(2)需求缺乏弹性时，交换费上限反而提高均衡奖励和信用卡采纳，加剧交叉补贴，使持卡人受益但可能损害现金用户；(3)需求弹性较大时，交换费上限降低奖励和信用卡使用，对两组用户均有利；(4)刻画了交换费上限提升配置效率并鼓励社会合意支付选择的条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公共财政的税收楔子概念引入支付卡市场分析，揭示了交换费监管的福利效应取决于需求弹性这一关键条件，修正了传统认知，丰富了双边市场定价与监管理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计交换费上限监管提供了条件依赖的分析框架：监管效果因市场中的消费者需求弹性而异，需在保护现金用户与促进信用卡市场效率之间权衡。

reference: IMF Working Paper No. 2026/103
title: One Global Shock, Many Inflation Paths
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: One Global Shock, Many Inflation Paths

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates why the post-COVID inflation surge, though globally synchronized, led to widely divergent outcomes across countries. Using cross-country regressions for 130 economies and local projections methods for 70 advanced and emerging markets, we analyze the structural, institutional, and policy determinants of post-pandemic inflation dynamics. The results indicate that historical inflation and the scale of domestic energy price shocks account for most of the cross-country variation in cumulative post-COVID inflation. In contrast, many frequently cited country-specific, macroeconomic fundamentals and institutional features exhibit limited power to explain cross-country variation. The association between post-COVID inflation and domestic policy responses is also weak, although endogeneity complicates a clear causal interpretation. The analysis further reveals that pass-through from energy prices to headline inflation intensified markedly in the post-COVID period, particularly in emerging markets, in non-inflation-targeting regimes, and in countries that did not expand fossil fuel subsidies. These findings highlight the asymmetric transmission of supply shocks and underscore the importance of credibility, historical inflation experience, and energy policy design in shaping inflation persistence. Strengthening central bank credibility and anchoring expectations may be essential to bolster resilience against future global supply disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了为什么后疫情时代的通胀在全球同步爆发，却在各国产生了截然不同的结果。通过分析130个经济体的跨国回归和70个发达与新兴市场的局部投影方法，发现历史通胀水平和国内能源价格冲击的规模解释了大部分跨国通胀差异，而许多常被引用的宏观经济基本面、制度特征和政策回应解释力有限。能源价格向整体通胀的传导在后疫情时期显著增强，尤其是在新兴市场、非通胀目标制国家和未扩大化石燃料补贴的国家。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时代全球同步爆发的通胀为何在不同国家产生了截然不同的结果？哪些结构性、制度性和政策性因素可以解释这种跨国差异？
AI.motivation: 后疫情时期全球经历了同步的通胀飙升，但各国的通胀严重程度和持续时间差异巨大。现有文献虽已从多个角度讨论了通胀成因，但对这种跨国差异的系统性解释仍然不足，特别是关于哪些结构性、制度性因素真正解释了一国通胀相对于其他国家的高低。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通货膨胀的决定因素理论（历史通胀惯性）、能源价格传导机制（pass-through效应）、中央银行可信度与通胀预期锚定理论、通胀目标制度与非目标制度下的通胀差异、财政补贴政策对价格冲击的缓冲作用。
AI.method: 对130个经济体进行跨国截面回归分析（cross-country regressions），同时对70个发达和新兴市场采用局部投影方法（local projections methods），考察后疫情时期通胀动态的结构性、制度性和政策性决定因素。
AI.findings: (1) 历史通胀水平和国内能源价格冲击的规模解释了大部分跨国通胀差异；(2) 许多常被引用的宏观经济基本面、制度特征对解释跨国通胀差异能力有限；(3) 政策回应与通胀之间的关联较弱，且存在内生性；(4) 能源价格向整体通胀的传导在后疫情时期显著增强；(5) 这种传导增强在新兴市场、非通胀目标制国家和未扩大化石燃料补贴的国家尤为突出。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球同步供给冲击下通胀跨国差异的关键决定因素，强调了历史通胀惯性（通胀记忆）和能源价格传导强度的核心作用；提出了供给冲击的非对称传导机制，丰富了关于能源价格传导和通胀持久性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行和政策制定者提供了实证依据：加强央行可信度、锚定通胀预期、以及审慎设计能源补贴政策（而非简单地扩大补贴）是增强经济对未来全球供给冲击韧性的关键；对于新兴市场和非通胀目标制国家尤其具有政策启示。

title: Pluralism Breeds Tolerance
affiliations: IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca, University of Pennsylvania,  and Maastricht University

detail.title: Pluralism Breeds Tolerance

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Shared norms and tolerance of dissent are cornerstones of democracy, the rule of law, and effective governance. Yet societies often harbor deep normative disagreements, raising a foundational question: how does normative pluralism -- the coexistence of divergent moral standards -- shape the enforcement of norms and the maintenance of social order? We design a new task to measure perceptions of pluralism and show in two pre-registered experiments that perceived normative pluralism softens moral judgment and reduces punishment. When individuals are induced to consider that others may think differently, their condemnation of transgressions is tempered, and they punish less. Thus, pluralism breeds tolerance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两项预注册实验发现，当个体感知到规范多元主义（即他人可能持有不同道德标准）时，他们的道德判断会软化，惩罚行为也会减少，表明多元主义能够催生宽容。
AI.research_question: 规范多元主义——不同道德标准共存——如何影响规范的执行和社会秩序的维持？
AI.motivation: 社会常存在深层的规范分歧，而共享规范与容忍异见是民主、法治和有效治理的基石。因此需要理解规范多元主义如何塑造人们对规范的执行与惩罚行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规范多元主义理论、道德判断与惩罚行为相关理论。
AI.method: 设计新任务测量对多元主义的感知，并开展两项预注册实验。
AI.findings: 感知到的规范多元主义会软化道德判断、减少惩罚行为。当个体意识到他人可能持有不同看法时，对违规行为的谴责会减轻，惩罚也更少。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了规范多元主义如何通过改变个体的道德认知与惩罚决策来影响社会秩序，为多元主义与宽容之间的关系提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解如何在多元社会中维持秩序与宽容的平衡提供了实证依据，对政策制定、社会治理和法治建设具有参考价值。
